description: Light DOM orchestrator for chat UI

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: API endpoint; POSTs { message, model } (latest message only) and reads html/message/content from the JSON reply. Omit for custom transport

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Active model; synced with [data-model-select] (property-driven after connect)

events.name: chat-window:send
events.description: A message was sent and no endpoint is set; finish with resolveTyping(typingElement, html)

events.name: chat-window:messages-changed
events.description: The messages setter updated the thread

childAttributes.name: data-participants
childAttributes.description: JSON participant map: { id: { name, role } }

childAttributes.name: data-model-select
childAttributes.description: Model selector inside the header; synced with model

childAttributes.name: data-role
childAttributes.description: Message role; user content is always text

childAttributes.name: data-from-label
childAttributes.description: Sender name (written by the runtime from participants)

childAttributes.name: data-chat-typing
childAttributes.description: Visually hidden typing label inside a typing chat-bubble (runtime)

structure.description: Composer; its chat-input:send drives the send cycle

properties.name: messages
properties.description: Get the thread as data, or assign to replace the whole thread (keyed diff by id); content is text for role user, sanitized HTML otherwise

methods.name: appendMessage(role, content, from?)
methods.description: Append and return a chat-message; user content is text, other roles sanitized HTML

methods.name: resolveTyping(el, content, { error? })
methods.description: Finish a typing placeholder: fill its bubble, clear data-status (or set error) and the typing label

methods.name: scrollToBottom()
methods.description: Scroll the thread to the newest message
